messages:
ana: Quick sync: marketing flagged inconsistent product naming across docs (some places say 'Redwood', others 'Redwood Inference', and a couple spots use 'Redwood Inference Platform'). Need recommendations.

 tom: My take: external-facing <= use 'Redwood Inference' first mention, then 'Redwood' after. Internal API/console copy can use 'Redwood' only.

 li: Agreed. Also spotted `model variant` vs `model-variant` vs `variant` across API refs. We should pick one canonical term.

 lexi: Proposal: canonical glossary entries: 'Redwood Inference' (product name), 'Redwood' (short form), 'model variant' (two words, lowercase) and 'rollout policy' (two words).

 ana: Good. Any objections to lowercasing these as common nouns in code and docs? e.g., "model variant" not "Model Variant" unless it's a header.

 tom: Lowercase in body text, Title Case for headings. Make a line in style guide.

 li: Found a customer-facing tutorial that used "Redwood Inference Platform" in a sentence. That feels clunky; we should patch to "Redwood Inference". I'll open a PR.

 docs-bot: Note added: STYLE-980 created — "Product name normalization + variant term canonicalization". Link: https://redwood.example.dev/STYLE-980

 ana: Also small ask: SDK snippet param naming — some Python snippets use lowerCamelCase for maxTokens. Let's add a checklist item to PR template to verify param casing per language.

 lexi: Already in the style guide but not enforced. I can add a short snippet table: JS -> lowerCamelCase, Python -> snake_case, Go -> LowerCamel (exported fields OK).

 tom: For searchability, add redirection metadata to any pages we rename (internal redirects). Don't delete old slugs until after 2 weeks.

 li: One more: error messages. Marketing prefers a warmer tone in some docs, engineering prefers neutral. We need a rule: error strings in API reference = neutral/concise; user-facing product help = slightly conversational.

 ana: Yes — add rule: "Tone: concise for errors; helpful and friendly for how-to and marketing content."

 lexi: I'll draft the glossary changes and a short PR description. Sample glossary entry for review: 

```
model variant — a specific trained checkpoint or configuration derived from a model family. Used for routing, rollout, and cost calculations.
```

 li: Nice. For 'rollout policy' sample: 

```
rollout policy — a set of rules controlling model selection, canary weights, and fallback behavior during deployments.
```

 tom: Ping infra: if any changes affect telemetry names (metrics) we must not rename metric keys. Only human-facing text.

 ana: Good reminder. We'll include that in PR checklist.

 docs-bot: PR checklist item added: "Confirm only user-facing strings changed; metrics/log keys untouched."

 lexi: I'll open the docs PR (will include list of files and suggested edits). Requesting reviews from @ana and @li.

 li: I'll do a quick grep + propose patches. ETA EOD.

 ana: Thanks all. If we can land the naming normalization this week, we can ship a small release note called "Docs: naming and glossary updates (Mar 2026)".

 tom: Sounds good. I'll coordinate redirects with webops once PR merges.

 ana: Closing loop — anything else?

 lexi: Nothing else from me. Will post PR link when ready. :sparkles:
